contract_structures.typical_duration: 5 to 10 years for underground operational management contracts; 3 to 5 years for surface/opencast plant management. Labour TES placements are often rolling 12-month or linked to mine life-of-section.

typical_contract_values.underground_mining_management: R500m to R5bn+ (e.g., Boipelo Arnot contract: R3.2bn over contract term)
typical_contract_values.surface_plant_management: R100m to R1bn depending on throughput and scope
typical_contract_values.TES_labour_supply: Typically per-head day rate contracts, often R50,000â€“R120,000 per employee per month fully loaded

key_terms: BBBEE Level 1 or Level 2 preferred/required by most majors
Joint venture structures common (majority Black-owned JV partner required by some mining houses)
MHSA compliance and safety performance KPIs standard
Section 198 LRA compliance certification typically required
Local community employment and enterprise development obligations

active_procurers.procurement_activity: Highest-volume coal operational management procurer. Matla LOME Project (R5.2bn, 2025â€“2043) requires extensive contractor and operational management support. Also active at Grootegeluk, Leeuwpan, and Mafube (50/50 JV with Thungela).

Opened Naudesbank Colliery (March 2025). Underground phase commencing ~2027 will require specialist underground management contractors. Also operates Middelburg (Optimum/Koornfontein), Klipspruit, and Kriel mines.
Zibulo North Shaft Extension Project (R2.5bn) creates contractor demand for underground management. Operates Elders, Goedehoop, Greenside, Isibonelo, Mafube (JV) and Zibulo collieries.
